PLAN "Bone-Loading Strength Programme - Starts 2026-06-01"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain and build bone density and muscle mass through progressive compound loading, with heat-safe session structure"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Base Loading" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower A":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5..6 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 10m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper A":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5..6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 10m
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Lower B":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 4x4..6 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
